Maria Chen: quick heads-up, CI perf alert on qwen2.5, saw tail latency spike on a canary with rope_scale=0.75 + ALiBi fallback
Samir Patel: ugh, details?
Maria Chen: run attached: ./bin/infer --model qwen2p5 --rope-scale 0.75 --kernel autoselect --batch 8 --streaming=false --profile /tmp/prof-1768.json
perf-bot: profiling finished, summary: p50=6.3ms/token, p95=12.8ms/token, p99=27.2ms/token (baseline on main: p95=8.1ms/token) :warning:
Cheng Li: any kernel fallback logs? autoselect should prefer our AVX-optimized kernel for this model.
Maria Chen: digging — profiler shows a chunk of requests using generic-kernel instead of qwen2p5-opt. stack: kernel_selector -> compatible_kernel_check -> (rejected) qwen2p5-opt :thinking:
Dave R.: why rejected? mismatch in kv heads? we added a strict head/kv dimension check in kernel selector last month.
Maria Chen: exact snippet from selector log: "candidate=qwen2p5-opt kv_heads=64 kernel_kv_heads=32 -> incompatible"
Katie O'Neill: wait how did kv_heads change at runtime? model config should be 64 for both.
Cheng Li: found it — tokenizer split issue for multilingual inputs. For some CJK and mixed-latin sequences we were accidentally creating an extra token that triggers relayout path, and that path uses a legacy cached-config which reports kv_heads=32.
Samir Patel: oh wow. any repro?
Maria Chen: repro attached, input: "用户: 请翻译 This is a test" => token ids show: [1234, 5678, 9, 10, 11] but the tokenizer on canary produced [1234, 99, 5678, 9, 10, 11] (extra 99). KV cache key for that codepath stored shape (32, head_dim) instead of (64, head_dim).
Cheng Li: that explains reduced KV cache hit-rate. I instrumented hit-rate: baseline 99.2% -> canary 67.4% overall, and kernel selector sees cached-config (32 heads) and refuses optimized kernel -> fall back generic -> higher latency.
Dave R.: can we relax the kernel selector to compare total_kv_dim instead of kv_heads alone? If head_dim*kv_heads matches expected, we could treat as compatible. :+1:
Katie O'Neill: possible but risky. head_count mismatch can break attention math unless we reshape carefully. Another option: on cache load, detect legacy shape and convert (reshape/replicate) to expected kv shape when safe.
Samir Patel: quick patch idea: if cached_kv_heads is divisor or multiple of expected_heads and head_dim aligns, attempt cheap reshape path and mark cache as migrated. I can prototype.
Cheng Li: also flagged tokenizer bug — the extra token 99 comes from the multilingual fallback BPE table for "用户:" when followed by space-latin. Fix upstream tokenizer and add unit tests for mixed CJK+latin separators.
Maria Chen: perf numbers after a quick local patch (cherry-pick reshape-on-load): p95 dropped from 12.8 to 8.6ms/token, p99 from 27.2 to 14.1ms/token on the same trace. KV hit-rate back to 97%.
perf-bot: attach flamegraph link: https://perf.internal/redwood/1768124000/flame.svg
Samir Patel: nice. two parallel actions: (1) Cheng fixes tokenizer in devex; (2) Samir lands safe reshape + migration in kernel selector. We should also add a regression test in runtime/integration that simulates mixed-ling token splits.
Katie O'Neill: agree. also add watch alert: sudden drop in kv_hit_rate > 10% triggers automatic canary rollback.
Dave R.: small note — we should avoid silently reshaping incompatible heads across quantized kernels (int8 paths). Add explicit opt-in for quantized kernels.
Cheng Li: noted. I'll open two PRs: tokenizer fix + integration test.
Samir Patel: I'll prototype reshape-on-load and a kernel selector change (fallback to qwen2p5-opt after reshape) and include a flag runtime.enable_kv_migration = true for safety.
Maria Chen: timeline?
Cheng Li: tokenizer PR today, tests tomorrow.
Samir Patel: reshape PR by end of day, will run canary once CI passes.
Katie O'Neill: I'll update the canary checklist and add kv_hit_rate to the gating metrics.
Maria Chen: thanks team. leaving notes for postmortem: root cause = tokenizer-induced cache shape mismatch -> kernel selector strictness -> generic-kernel fallback -> tail latency regression. Two mitigations: fix tokenizer, add KV migration + selector relaxation with flags.
Dave R.: small TODO: audit other models (mixtral/mistral) for similar legacy cached-config layouts — could be a systemic issue.
Maria Chen: added to backlog (infra-ticket #4532). I'll monitor the canary after PRs. :rocket:
